subject: [D-RUG]: D-RUG Weekly Work Session & Rmarkdown presentation by Rich Pauloo

messages.author: 91fcdff1323a6831
messages.subject: [D-RUG]: D-RUG Weekly Work Session & Rmarkdown presentation by Rich Pauloo
parts:
Hi folks,

This week we will have another presentation, this time on how to use RMarkdown for a number of things (CV, reports, presentations, etc). Rich Pauloo will give a tutorial and overview of this tool, so please come join us at tomorrow at 10am, in the DSI (360 Shields). We will screen cast the event via youtube, so you can watch the presentation live or later (HERE) if you can't make it. I'll post any materials Rich provides on the website as well. 

Upcoming Presentations:

  • Nov 16: Kate Tiedman:  using raster /raster calculations in R
  • Nov 30: Ryan Peek: mapmaking with R/RStudio

PACKAGE OF THE WEEK:

Currently there are 11, 712 total packages on CRAN. This week a package I'd like to put out in the ether is cowplot. It makes it pretty easy to grid or arrange multiple ggplots, and make very nice polished figures for manuscripts or publishing wherever. Plenty of great options within the package. Check it out.

Do you have a package you really enjoy using? Please send it/them my way! Here's a google form we can use to compile all of these: https://goo.gl/forms/VzzeldnaEOkNImJ73.

If you want to see the packages that I've mentioned thus far this quarter, there's a table here.

Thanks much,
Adios,
Ryan

--

If you plan on attending the workshop tomorrow, you can find the materials in the attached zipped folder, on the website later on, or at this repo. Options abound!

Cheers,
